checked.comment: Finite linear bandit, actions spanning R^d, standard Gaussian noise; algorithm input is A and n so T known; sigma implicitly known (N(0,1)).
Registry id end_of_optimism_optimal matches the three-phase Optimal Algorithm.
Corollary 2: limsup R/log n >= c(A,theta) for consistent policies with unique optimal arm; correctly recorded.
Theorem 10: limsup R/log n <= c(A,theta) assuming unique x*; known horizon since n is input.

summary: The extraction is accurate and complete. Both of the paper's asymptotic regret guarantees, the lower bound in Corollary 2 and the matching upper bound in Theorem 10, are recorded correctly with appropriate settings, conditions and provenance. Theorem 1, which only constrains how pulls are allocated, and Theorem 8, a concentration inequality, are reasonably left out.
